===Rallying the troops===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to Father Badden outside.
*Convince Father Reen to join the ritual. {{Chat option|3Oh, don't be so simple-minded!}}
*Talk to the golem, he will refuse to help. {{Chat option|3I could just reprogram you again.}}
*Use the Strange implement on the golem to reprogram him.
*Talk to the golem again to make him enter the dungeon.
}}
